error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect. Check the IP address, port, and local key.

data.weather_entity: Home Assistant weather entity to show (leave empty to let the device fetch Open-Meteo for its Weather: Location)
data.weather_scale: Temperature scale on the display (auto = the entity's unit)
data.update_repo: GitHub repository whose CI publishes the bridge software builds (owner/name)
data.github_token: GitHub token to read those builds (only needed while the repository is private; read access to contents)
